review_scope: All 24 whole entity definitions, aliases, applicability values and family source facts.
All 96 complete source documents in authored paragraph order, including all long surrounding sections.
All 96 semantic labels, exact core/full target spans, selected occurrence indices and QA identity metadata.
All 216 literal support spans, ownership annotations, 36 contradiction annotations and allowed missing attributes.
Country, operational stage, referent kind, organizational scope, real quotation versus metalinguistic use, compositional person referents, NIL and unresolved shared aliases.
All 12 family identities and 96 event/document/parent identities, length/label and shared-target attribute balancing.
All 60 new lexical names against the exact hashes and contents of 23 prior tracked fixture artifacts.

review_method.paragraph_rendering: Every document was read in its original paragraph order. Byte-identical repeated paragraphs used explicit references to their earlier complete rendering; unique paragraphs were shown in full, never summarized.
review_method.literal_and_identity_audit: Source-only JSON/hash/span checks supplement independent semantic reading; no resolver output or model proposal was used to set labels.

known_limitations: Fictional AI-authored and independently AI-reviewed sources; not human gold, natural workplace sampling or an operational risk estimate.
Twelve families share eight controlled challenge structures and three writing styles. Paired conditions and family events are not independent replications.
Long examples contain substantive surrounding prose but reuse many exact paragraphs within a writing style; length stress is controlled rather than naturally sampled.

Shared-alias target role, country, kind and stage are balanced, but explicit/implicit unique-name positives favor A and cross-paragraph positives favor B. Balancing does not remove all source correlations.
Independent event boundaries, correction statements and mismatch explanations are deliberately explicit and may make some cases easier than natural documents.
Exact prior-name exclusion does not establish semantic novelty, absence of near-duplicates or absence from model pretraining.
Support annotations are scoring metadata only and must not enter prompts, retrieval candidate generation, method selection or execution authorization.
